about: The one table of the CDL expression grammar. The libraries' generator runs every case through its own evaluator, and the resolver runs the same file through its evaluator. An env value is a number, a Boolean, an enum item name or a list. A dotted name under the `enumPrefix` is an enum literal whose value is its last segment; any other dotted name is unknown. `want` is the value; a refused case refuses with an error that quotes `src`.

accept.note: TerminalUnits.Reheat.Controller's protected heaCoi, the only if-expression in a G36 default

accept.src: if rowMax then size(u,1) else size(u,2)
accept.note: kw.cdl's MatrixMax output size; MatrixMin's is the same with rowMin

accept.src: if a then if b then 1 else 2 else 3
accept.note: nesting: an if in a then branch

accept.src: if a then 1 else if b then 2 else 3
accept.note: nesting: an if in an else branch, Modelica's way to write elseif
precedence: the else branch extends as far as it can

accept.src: if a > 1 and not b then 10 else 20
accept.note: precedence: the whole condition up to then
an if inside an operator, in parentheses
an if as a function argument

refuse.src: if a then 1 elseif b then 2 else 3
refuse.note: elseif occurs in no G36 expression, so it is not supported
a condition that is not a Boolean
an if inside an operator without parentheses
